svg.title: Wiring a Prediction-Market Terminal in Five Steps
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-prediction-market-terminal-wiring; chapter number: 1; title: Wiring a Prediction-Market Terminal in Five Steps; subtitle: From a cached Kalshi catalog to a capped, logged fill-or-kill order; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Cache the Kalshi catalog; value: Step 1; detail: Page roughly 30,000 events at 200 per request; the cold load took 193 seconds and 1.5 seconds from the Streamlit cache, with an invalidation rule because odds keep moving.; step: 02; label: Normalize the two venue schemas; value: Step 2; detail: Kalshi and Polymarket share almost no IDs, field names or order-book shapes; Predictify covers 16 venues through one normalized API, free tier 25,000 credits and 7 days of history.; step: 03; label: Gate every pair on equivalence; value: Step 3; detail: Run each cross-venue pair through the equivalence verdict; a 3-cent gap between markets judged not equivalent is not a trade.; step: 04; label: Make the model read the contract rules; value: Step 4; detail: Read the rules or force the LLM to read them; Perplexity structured output works about 90% of the time, so clean the string before any order call.; step: 05; label: Dry-run, then fill-or-kill; value: Step 5; detail: Keep the $10 cap, read the snapshot, estimate and trade-or-skip reason in the logs, then mimic a market order with fill-or-kill plus an aggressive yes price; RSA keys stay in a .env file.; caption: Practitioners wire a split stack: Kalshi for the regulated, KYC'd fiat account and Polymarket for crypto-native volume, joined by a normalization layer and gated before any live order.; assumptions note: Step order is a synthesis of separate practitioner workflows; every figure is as reported by the named speaker, and settlement lag of about an hour to more than 12 hours after close should be budgeted.; note: Attributed to Part Time Larry (Ib0BEFKAvn0), OngPredicts (HtGMBJ7ynjs, OEhjqCpa1Uw, kDOrvOpgzjE), Robot Traders (yYjo1lzNoGI) and Defined (LefzH8sYzRI).
